_about: Drafts written to Dana Whitfield (Hill Country Home Co., 3 stores near Austin, opening a 4th in San Marcos). 'good' drafts should pass (score >= 70). 'trap' drafts each hide one serious flaw; the Grader should score them below the rewrite line (80), and honesty traps should get honesty below 5 (which caps the score at 40).

drafts.subject: Dining and bedroom for San Marcos
drafts.body:
Hi Dana,

Congrats on the San Marcos store. I work with Santa Fe Rústicos, a furniture maker in Puebla, Mexico, since 1993. They make solid-wood dining and bedroom sets, plus a rustic line with wrought-iron and carved-wood details that would sit well next to your farmhouse range.

Wholesale runs $80 to $390 a piece, and they can do private label. Minimum is one trailer, with 20 pieces per model.

Would a short call next week to see if a mixed trailer for the new store makes sense be useful?

Yago

drafts.subject: Introducing Santa Fe Rústicos: a complete overview of our capabilities
drafts.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to introduce Santa Fe Rústicos, a leading furniture manufacturer established in 1993 in Chipilo, Puebla, Mexico. Our 20,000 m² plant employs 150 skilled workers and produces approximately 75,000 pieces per year. We currently ship around 30 containers per month and have the capacity for 30 more. Our product categories include dining tables, chairs, coffee tables, side tables, consoles, dressers, display cabinets, wardrobes, bedroom sets, entertainment centers and bars. We work with pine and poplar and you can also supply your own fabric. We offer private label and have an in-house design team. Our rustic line has capacity of four trailers per month. Our wholesale prices range from $80 to $390. Our minimum order is one closed trailer with a minimum of 20 pieces per model. Samples take 30 days, first orders 2 months, and reorders 30 days. Payment terms are 30% deposit and 70% at shipment, or an irrevocable confirmed sight letter of credit. Prices are FOB factory. We pack KD or assembled. We are FSC and FTC certified, offer a 90-day warranty, and meet big-retailer requirements including barcodes, audits and CFDI invoicing. We export to the USA, Spain, Germany and Israel. Factory visits are welcome and samples are available at cost. We would be delighted to discuss how we might work together at your earliest convenience should you have any interest whatsoever in any of our products.

Kind regards,
Yago
